C1.rule: Mechanical, one owned file, fully specified, no design choice

C2.rule: Bounded implementation or tests, clear spec, one or two owned files and their tests

C3.rule: Cross-module design; changes a gate or the ledger contract; wrong means every project inherits it

C4.rule: Planning, merging, reconciling, anything in a project's real data, a sponsor decision

phases.name: Warmup and reheat
phases.goal: Two commands with the standard inside, run by the hooks and the dispatcher, so a lead's whole life needs no typing; both take free-text context.
phases.exit: R-01 to R-05 merged; one item lead started by the dispatcher warms up, compacts, reheats and ends with no sponsor action.

phases.name: Research
phases.goal: Questions that need reading, not writing, before they become items, a proposal, or a decline.
phases.exit: Every X row is done only when it becomes items, a numbered proposal, or a recorded decline with the reason -- never a report nobody acted on.

items.title: bin/warmup runs the standard every time, in both modes
items.what: bin/warmup (full) and bin/warmup --reheat (since the last checkpoint or state) both run conformance and rulecheck --mandatory; each non-holding item and each new Standard change becomes a ledger item via tracker set/ask, ahead of other queued work.
items.done: Tests: a fixture project behind the rules gets the Standard change queued in both modes; a holding project gets nothing new.

items.title: /warmup and /reheat skills with context; /standard becomes a shortcut
items.what: skills/warmup rewritten for a fresh lead; new skills/reheat for a running one; both accept free-text context (the sponsor's D1 note) shown as a Context line on the card and carried into the first steps. skills/standard becomes a one-release shortcut to /warmup with a notice, then is removed.
items.done: Skill files and templates updated with a Standard change line; test that context text reaches the card.

items.title: Hooks run warmup and reheat by themselves
items.what: Measure first: can hooks/sessionstart run bin/warmup within Claude Code's hook limits? Then SessionStart startup runs warmup, compact or resume runs reheat; the Stop hook notices a new rules version and asks for reheat. Never fails a session.
items.done: Timing recorded in the ledger; hook tests for startup, compact, resume and a rules change; derecord installs them.

items.title: Dispatcher starts a new lead with /warmup <item> [context]
items.what: When a lead passes its closing check (proposal 24 H-01), the dispatcher (H-02) starts the next item lead whose first message is /warmup <item> plus any context. Built with proposal 24's H-03.
items.done: One item lead started by the dispatcher runs warmup with no sponsor action, session ids recorded.

log.evidence: C4/lead model -> C2/sonnet: dispatcher sends /warmup <item> [context]; bounded build with tests: a Sonnet builder, briefed with a Haiku scout's context pack; the lead only reviews and merges. Sponsor: "refactor to utilize lower agents as much as possible" (15 Sep 2026).

items.title: Fast-forward the shared common-rules checkout when behind
items.what: warmup and reheat run git -C <rules checkout> pull --ff-only when it is behind origin/main, on main, with no tracked changes; otherwise they say why on the card. Never merges, rebases or stashes.
items.done: Tests on a temp clone: behind and clean fast-forwards; dirty, diverged or not on main leaves it alone with a card line.
